# 1 Chronicles Chapter 23 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 382r–382v

---

**23:1** And-David was-old [zaqen] and-full [save'a] of-days, and-he-made-king [vayyamlikh] Shelomoh his-son over Yisra'el.

**23:2** And-he-gathered all the-princes [sarey] of-Yisra'el and-the-priests [ha-kohanim] and-the-Levites [ha-leviyyim].

**23:3** And-were-numbered [vayyissafru] the-Levites from-a-son of-thirty years [sheloshim shanah] and-upward [va-ma'elah], and-was their-number [mispar] by-their-heads [le-gulgolotam], man by-man [gever bi-gever], thirty-eight thousand [sheloshim u-shemonah elef].

**23:4** From-these — to-oversee [lenatse'ach] over the-work [melekhet] of-the-house of-YHWH, twenty-four thousand [esrim ve-arba'ah elef]; and-officers [shoterim] and-judges [shoftim], six thousand [sheshet alafim];

**23:5** and-four thousand gate-keepers [sho'arim]; and-four thousand praising [mehallelim] YHWH with-the-instruments [ba-khelim] that I-made [asiti] for-praising [le-hallel].

**23:6** And-divided-them David [into] divisions [machleqot] for-the-sons of-Levi: for-Gershon, Qehat, and-Merari.

**23:7** Of-the-Gershoni: La'dan and-Shim'i.

**23:8** The-sons of-La'dan: the-head [ha-rosh] Yechi'el, and-Zetam, and-Yo'el — three.

**23:9** The-sons of-Shim'i: Shelomit, and-Chazi'el, and-Haran — three. These [were] the-heads of-the-fathers [rashey ha-avot] of-La'dan.

**23:10** And-the-sons of-Shim'i: Yachat, Zina, and-Ye'ush, and-Beri'ah. These [were] the-sons of-Shim'i — four.

**23:11** And-was Yachat the-head [ha-rosh], and-Zizah the-second. And-Ye'ush and-Beri'ah did-not-have many [lo hirbu] sons, and-they-became a-father's-house [beit av] for-one reckoning [lifqudah echat].

**23:12** The-sons of-Qehat: Amram, Yitshar, Chevron, and-Uzzi'el — four.

**23:13** The-sons of-Amram: Aharon and-Mosheh. And-was-set-apart [vayyibbadel] Aharon to-consecrate-him [lehaqdiysho] as-most-holy [qodesh qodashim] — he and-his-sons until eternity [ad olam] — to-burn-incense [lehaqtir] before YHWH, to-minister [leshareto] to-him, and-to-bless [ulevarekh] in-his-name until eternity.

**23:14** And-Mosheh the-man of-Elohim [ish ha-elohim] — his-sons were-called upon the-tribe [shevet] of-Levi.

**23:15** The-sons of-Mosheh: Gershom and-Eli'ezer.

**23:16** The-sons of-Gershom: Shevu'el the-head [ha-rosh].

**23:17** And-the-sons of-Eli'ezer: Rechavyah the-head. And-was-not to-Eli'ezer other sons [banim acherim], and-the-sons of-Rechavyah multiplied [ravu] exceedingly [le-ma'elah].

**23:18** The-sons of-Yitshar: Shelomit the-head.

**23:19** The-sons of-Chevron: Yeriyyahu the-head, Amaryahu the-second, Yachazi'el the-third, and-Yeqam'am the-fourth.

**23:20** The-sons of-Uzzi'el: Mikhah the-head, and-Yishshiyyah the-second.

**23:21** The-sons of-Merari: Machli and-Mushi. The-sons of-Machli: El'azar and-Qish.

**23:22** And-died El'azar, and-not were to-him sons [lo hayu lo vanim], but [only] daughters [banot], and-took-them the-sons of-Qish, their-kinsmen [acheyhem].

**23:23** The-sons of-Mushi: Machli, and-Eder, and-Yeremot — three.

**23:24** These [were] the-sons of-Levi by-the-house of-their-fathers [beit avotam], the-heads of-the-fathers [rashey ha-avot], according-to-their-reckoning [bifquddatam] in-the-number [be-mispar] of-names by-their-heads [le-gulgolotam], doers of-the-work [osey ha-melakhah] for-the-service [la'avodat] of-the-house of-YHWH, from-a-son of-twenty years [esrim shanah] and-upward.

**23:25** For said David: YHWH Elohey Yisra'el has-given-rest [heniach] to-his-people, and-he-dwells [vayyishkon] in-Yerushalayim until eternity.

**23:26** And-also for-the-Levites — there-is-no [eyn] to-carry [laset] the-tabernacle [ha-mishkan] and-all its-vessels for-its-service [la'avodato].

**23:27** For by-the-last-words [be-acharoney] of-David — they [are] the-number [mispar] of-the-sons of-Levi from-a-son of-twenty years and-upward.

**23:28** For their-station [ma'amadam] [was] at-the-hand [le-yad] of-the-sons of-Aharon for-the-service [la'avodat] of-the-house of-YHWH, over the-courts [ha-chatserot] and-over the-chambers [ha-leshakhot] and-over the-cleansing [tohorat] of-every-holy-thing [kol qodesh] and-the-work of-the-service [ma'asey avodat] of-the-house of-Elohim,

**23:29** and-for-the-bread of-the-row [lechem ha-ma'arekhet] and-for-the-fine-flour [solet] for-the-grain-offering [la-minchah] and-for-the-unleavened-wafers [riqey ha-matstsot] and-for-the-griddle-cakes [machabat] and-for-the-mixed-offering [murbeqet] and-for-every-measure [kol mesurat] of-capacity [middah] and-size [u-middah],

**23:30** and-to-stand [la'amod] every morning [ba-boqer] to-thank [lehodot] and-to-praise [ulehalel] YHWH, and-likewise at-evening [la-erev],

**23:31** and-for-every offering of-burnt-offerings [olot] to-YHWH on-the-Sabbaths [ba-shabbatot], on-the-new-moons [ba-chodashim], and-on-the-appointed-feasts [ba-mo'adim], by-number [be-mispar] according-to-the-ordinance [ka-mishpat] upon-them continually [tamid] before YHWH.

**23:32** And-they-shall-keep [veshamru] the-charge [mishmeret] of-the-tent of-meeting [ohel mo'ed] and-the-charge of-the-holy-place [ha-qodesh] and-the-charge of-the-sons of-Aharon, their-kinsmen [acheyhem], for-the-service [la'avodat] of-the-house of-YHWH.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.3 vs. v.24-27 — The age discrepancy:** Verse 3 counts Levites from age thirty, but verses 24 and 27 lower the threshold to age twenty. The text explains this as David's "last words" — a revision in his final administrative acts. Numbers 4:3 sets the age at thirty; Numbers 8:24 at twenty-five. David lowers it to twenty, reasoning that the Levites no longer need to carry the tabernacle (v.26) and the permanent temple requires a larger workforce.

**v.5 — "instruments that I made":** David claims to have personally designed musical instruments for worship. 2 Chronicles 29:26-27 and Amos 6:5 both associate David with musical innovation. The Chronicler presents David as the architect of Israel's worship music.

**v.13 — Aaron "set apart as most holy":** The phrase *qodesh qodashim* (holy of holies / most holy) is typically used for sacred objects, not persons. Its application to Aaron and his descendants elevates the Aaronic priesthood to the status of sacred furniture — permanently consecrated, set apart from ordinary Levitical service.

**v.22 — Daughters marrying kinsmen:** Eleazar dies without sons; his daughters marry the sons of Kish, their kinsmen. This reflects the inheritance law of Numbers 36 — daughters who inherit must marry within their tribe to prevent land transfer between tribes.

*— EMET*
